ican: I can use input speed × input size = output speed × output size.

cloze.title: Say it the exam way
cloze.text:
The data booklet gives: input speed × input [[size|weight|speed]] = output speed × output size. The size of a gear is its number of [[teeth|shafts|turns]].

A small driver gear turning a large driven gear makes the output [[slower|faster]].

In a compound gear train, two gears sit on the same [[shaft|tooth|gear]]. They turn at the same [[speed|size]]. Work out one pair of gears at a time.

For any gear train, velocity ratio = speed of [[input|output]] ÷ speed of output. The unit of speed is [[revs min⁻¹|RPM|m s⁻¹]].

check.q: State the data booklet relationship for the speeds and sizes of two meshing gears.
check.a: input speed × input size = output speed × output size

check.q: A 20-tooth driver gear turns at 300 revs min⁻¹. It meshes with a 60-tooth driven gear. Calculate the output speed.
check.a: 300 × 20 = output speed × 60, so output speed = 6000 ÷ 60 = 100 revs min⁻¹

check.q: Two gears are fixed on the same shaft. State what is the same about them.
check.a: They turn at the same speed, in the same direction.

check.q: A gear train has a velocity ratio of 5 : 1. The input speed is 1000 revs min⁻¹. Calculate the output speed.
check.a: output speed = speed of input ÷ VR = 1000 ÷ 5 = 200 revs min⁻¹

check.q: State the type of gear train that has two gears on the same shaft.
A 10-tooth driver gear turns at 600 revs min⁻¹. It meshes with a 30-tooth gear. Calculate the output speed.
check.a: 600 × 10 = output speed × 30, so output speed = 6000 ÷ 30 = 200 revs min⁻¹

paper2.alt: Pizzas are cooked when they move through an oven on a motorised conveyor. An electronic circuit with a thermistor, variable resistor, transistor, relay, diode and motor switches on the conveyor when the oven reaches a set temperature. (a) Describe, as the temperature increases, the operation of the (i) input sub-system, 2 marks, and (ii) process and output sub-systems, 2 marks. (b) Describe the function of (i) the relay, 1 mark, and (ii) the diode, 1 mark. To drive the conveyor, the motor is connected to a compound gear train: a 10-tooth input gear meshes with a 50-tooth gear; a 20-tooth gear on the same shaft meshes with a 60-tooth output gear. (c) Describe an advantage of a compound gear over a simple gear train. 1 mark. (d) Calculate the speed of the output gear when the input rotates at 250 revs per minute. Show all working and final unit. 4 marks. (e) Describe how friction in a mechanical system could be reduced. 1 mark.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2014 Question 16. (a)(i) As the temperature increases the resistance of the thermistor drops, the voltage across it drops and the voltage across the variable resistor increases. (ii) The transistor switches on when the voltage reaches the set level; the relay switches on; the motor spins. (b)(i) Allows the low voltage circuit to control the more powerful circuit. (ii) Protects the transistor. (c) Allows a large ratio with small gears, or the same ratio in a smaller space; not just smaller or more efficient. (d) First pair: 10 x 250 = 50 x T, T = 50 revs per minute. Second pair: 50 x 20 = 60 x T, T = 16.7 revs per minute. Substitution and answer 1 mark each. (e) Lubricate moving parts, smoother materials where mechanisms interact, or add bearings to the shaft. No single word answers.

paper2.lead: Build It D3 in your booklet (the pizza oven conveyor) is based on this question. Parts (a) and (b) are electronics, from Booklet 3.

paper2.alt: A wind farm is shown in a photograph. A pupil's model of the wind turbine's compound gear train: the turbine blades turn a 48-tooth gear, which meshes with a 12-tooth gear; a 56-tooth gear on the same shaft meshes with an 8-tooth gear on the generator, which turns at 308 revs per minute. (d) Calculate the speed of the turbine blade. Show all working and final unit. 4 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2015 Question 10(d). Input speed x 56 = 308 x 8, input speed = 44; input speed x 48 = 44 x 12, input speed = 11 revs per minute. Or velocity ratio = 12/48 x 8/56 = 1 : 28, input speed = 1/28 x 308 = 11 revs per minute. Do not accept rpm.

paper2.alt: A laser cutting machine is used to cut sheet steel, shown in a photograph. Its motors are operated by a microcontroller; a pin table and a sequence of operations are given. Each motor drives a compound gear train: the motor at 1200 revs per minute turns a 15-tooth gear meshing with a 45-tooth gear; an 8-tooth gear on the same shaft meshes with a 36-tooth gear, gear X. (b)(i) State the name of this type of drive system. 1 mark. (ii) Calculate the output speed of gear X. 4 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for the specimen paper Question 13(b). (i) Compound gear. (ii) First pair: 15 x 1200 = 45 x output speed, output speed = 400 revs per minute. Second pair: 400 x 8 = 40 x output speed, output speed = 89 revs per minute. 1 mark for each substitution and each answer. Do not accept rpm.

paper2.lead: The marking instructions print 40 teeth in the second pair. The diagram shows 36 teeth. The answer, 89 revs min⁻¹, uses 36.

paper2.alt: A compound gear train in an industrial mixing machine is shown: the motor input at 880 revs per minute drives gear A with 8 teeth, meshing with gear B with 32 teeth; gear C with 16 teeth on the same shaft as B meshes with gear D with 32 teeth on the output to the mixer paddles. (a)(i) Calculate the output speed of the mixer paddles. (ii) Calculate the velocity ratio of the compound gear train. (b) The paddles rotate too slowly. Describe one change that could be made to gear B in order to increase the speed of the mixing paddles. 1 mark.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2018 Question 15. (a)(i) 8 x 880 = 32 x speed B, B = 220 revs per minute; 16 x 220 = 32 x speed D, D = 110 revs per minute. 4 marks. Do not accept RPM. Or output speed = 8/32 x 16/32 x 880 = 110. (ii) VR = input speed / output speed = 880 / 110 = 8 : 1 or 8. 2 marks. (b) Reduce the number of teeth, or make the gear smaller. 1 mark.

paper2.alt: A mechanical harvester used to pick fruit on a farm is shown in a photograph. Part of the conveyor belt mechanism: a motor at 2200 revs per minute turns gear A with 12 teeth, meshing with gear B with 48 teeth; gear C with 16 teeth on the same shaft as B meshes with gear D with 24 teeth. (b) Calculate the output speed of gear D. 4 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2019 Question 14(b). 2200 x 12 = output speed x 48, output speed = 550 revs per minute. 550 x 16 = output speed x 24, output speed = 366.7 = 370 revs per minute (2 significant figures). 1 mark for each substitution and each answer. Do not accept RPM. Or output speed = 12/48 x 16/24 x 2200.

paper2.alt: Hydropower is used to produce electricity from stored water in a reservoir. A diagram of a hydropower station and a sub-system diagram for the control of a motorised gate are shown. Part of the gear mechanism used to control the gate has a velocity ratio of 14 : 1 and an input speed of 870 revs per minute. (b) Calculate the output speed of this part of the gear mechanism. 3 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2022 Question 14(b). Velocity ratio = speed of input / speed of output. 14 = 870 / speed of output, 1 mark. Speed of output = 870 / 14, 1 mark. Speed of output = 62 revs per minute (2 significant figures), 1 mark. Do not accept RPM.

paper2.alt: A gear train is shown: four gears on three shafts, the input gear turning clockwise at 180 revs per minute and the output gear at 45 revs per minute. (a) State the name of this type of gear train. 1 mark. The input gear rotates clockwise. (b) State the direction of rotation of the output gear. 1 mark. (c) Calculate the velocity ratio of the gear train. 2 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2025 Question 4. (a) Compound (gear). (b) Clockwise. (c) Velocity ratio = speed of input / speed of output = 180 / 45 = 4 : 1. Accept 4; ignore any units.

paper2.alt: A carpet cleaner is shown, with a heater circuit. A possible drive system for the brush bar: the motor at 1500 revs per minute turns gear A with 52 teeth, which meshes with gear B with 12 teeth on the brush bar. (d) Calculate the output speed of the brush bar. 3 marks. During testing the brush bar did not rotate in the same direction as the motor. (e) Describe a modification to the drive system that would cause the brush bar to rotate in the same direction as the motor. 1 mark.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2025 Question 14. (d) In speed x in size = out speed x out size; 1500 x 52 = output speed x 12; output speed = 1500 x 52 / 12 = 6500 revs per minute. 1 mark each for substitution, transposition and the answer with unit. Do not accept RPM. (e) Use an idler gear: add a gear between gear A and gear B. Accept use a compound gear.

errors: Write the unit as revs min⁻¹. "RPM" got no mark (2019, 2022, 2025).
Start from the data booklet relationship. Work one pair of gears at a time (2024 course report).
Gears on the same shaft turn at the same speed. Carry the speed across before the next pair (2019).
Name it in full: compound gear train (2026 course report).
Round the answer: 366.7 revs min⁻¹ is written 370 revs min⁻¹, to 2 significant figures (2019).
